scope: Development acceptance suite. Used to identify capability gaps; not an untouched held-out accuracy benchmark.
common_checks: Visible correctly scaled geometry without unexpected intersections
Every offered export opens and matches preview
Refresh and reopen preserve geometry and conversation
Only report success for generated geometry; disclose unsupported operations

cases.prompt: Create an open-top electronics enclosure, 120 × 80 × 45 mm externally, with 3 mm walls and a 3 mm floor. Add four vertical screw posts, each 8 mm in outer diameter with a 3 mm through-hole. Position their centers 10 mm from the two nearest outside edges.
required: Holes pass through posts and floor

cases.prompt: Make an L-shaped mounting bracket, 50 mm wide, with a 70 mm horizontal leg and an 80 mm vertical leg. Both legs are 5 mm thick. Put two 6 mm through-holes in each leg, centered across its width and positioned 20 mm and 45 mm from the outside corner along that leg.

Design a one-piece phone stand with a 90 × 100 × 6 mm base. Its back support should be 80 mm wide, 110 mm long, 6 mm thick, and lean backward at 65 degrees to the base. Add a front retaining lip 12 mm high and a centered charging-cable opening 14 mm wide.

Create a stepped cylindrical shaft, 100 mm long overall. From left to right, use a 30 mm-long section of diameter 20 mm, a 40 mm-long section of diameter 14 mm, and a 30 mm-long section of diameter 10 mm. Add a 4 mm transverse through-hole at the midpoint of the largest section.

Make an open-top organizer, 180 × 120 × 35 mm externally, with 3 mm outer walls and floor. Divide the interior into six equal compartments arranged as three columns and two rows, using 2 mm-thick dividers.
required: Dividers connected to floor and walls

cases.prompt: Create a two-part cylindrical container with a removable slip-fit cap. The container body is 60 mm in outer diameter and 80 mm tall, with 3 mm walls and a 3 mm bottom. The cap has a 54.6 mm-diameter plug extending 10 mm below a 64 mm-diameter, 4 mm-thick top disc. Display the cap separately beside the body.
required: Identify 54 mm opening versus 54.6 mm plug

cases.prompt: Create a conceptual hinged box with a 100 × 70 × 40 mm open-top body, 3 mm walls and floor, and a separate 3 mm-thick lid. Put a three-knuckle hinge along the rear 100 mm edge, using a separate 3 mm-diameter pin and 3.6 mm-diameter bores. Show the lid open 90 degrees. No latch is needed.

Design a rectangular mounting plate 6 inches long, 4 inches wide, and 5 mm thick. Add four 6 mm through-holes, with each hole center 0.5 inches from its two nearest edges. Use millimeters in the final model.
Build a wall-mounted holder for my handheld barcode scanner. It should hold the scanner securely, let me remove it easily, and leave room for its charging cable.
required: Ask for device dimensions or reference
Do not invent size or guarantee fit

cases.prompt: Create an open-top tray, 160 × 100 × 30 mm externally, with 3 mm walls and floor. Add two 20 × 8 mm rectangular through-slots in the floor, centered at X = 40 mm and X = 120 mm, both at Y = 50 mm. Measure X and Y from the same outside corner.
cases.follow_up: Increase the outside height to 45 mm and add 5 mm-radius fillets to the four outside vertical corners. Keep the footprint, wall thickness, floor thickness, and both slots unchanged.
required: Preserve footprint walls floor and slots
